Definition: from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4982; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy:--excess, riot.
BiblicalUsage: This is the word for a life thrown away on excess, the riot that Paul sets against being filled with the Spirit. An elder's children must not be accused of it, and Peter says the world thinks it strange when believers refuse to run with them into the same flood of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the whole point: a life can be filled with wine or filled with the Spirit, but not both. The world's surprise at our refusal is itself a witness, and I hold that self-control is the quiet proof of a changed heart.
